hook: The 7th-seeded Columbus Crew defeated 2nd-seeded Inter Miami 3-0 in Game 1.

sections.voiceover: The 7th-seeded Columbus Crew defeated 2nd-seeded Inter Miami 3-0 in Game 1.
On Saturday, Gonzalo Tapia converted a 9th-minute penalty for Columbus Crew. The Chilean international later scored his second goal of the match. Could Inter Miami turn the match around down 2-0?
Instead, Inter Miami defender Gonzalo Luján saw red in the 36th minute.
Taha Habroune scored a second-half strike for Columbus Crew. Ten-man Inter Miami failed to score a single goal. That sealed a dominant 3-0 victory against the 2nd seed.
Columbus Crew now lead this MLS Cup Playoffs series 1-0.
